text:
Maya Patel: Quick check — API vs Console error copy for routing/quota failures. How much detail do we want in the API response vs what the Console banner should surface? Thinking: API minimal + machine hints; Console can show more human text and a CTA. Thoughts?

Henry Cole: +1 on minimal API. But we need a consistent 'hint' field clients can parse.

Sasha Ilyin: agree. Proposal: three fields: code (enum), brief (1 sentence), hint (codified short token). Example:

Henry Cole: ```json
{"code":"ROUTE_CAPACITY","brief":"This route is temporarily overloaded.","hint":"try_smaller_model_or_retry","retry_after":20}
```

Maya Patel: That looks good. Console would map hint tokens -> friendly text + actions. eg: "Try smaller model" button.

Kevin Zhao: important: include telemetry tags so we can correlate banner impressions with error events. We should include 'signal' tag and model_id in the error payload.

Sasha Ilyin: don't dump internal routing details into brief text. keep 'why' for logs only. 'brief' must be customer-safe.

Lia Gomez: UX note: console banner copy must be <140 chars. Example: "We're experiencing high load on this route. Try a smaller model or retry in ~20s." Keep CTA primary.

DeployBot: scheduled rollout: error-field-change -> canary 5% tomorrow 06:00 UTC

Henry Cole: telemetry sampling: record all 5xx and 429s for first 24h of rollouts, then sample 10% thereafter. Tag keys: error.code, error.hint, route, model, region.

Maya Patel: decision for rollout: API adds 'hint' optional string and 'code' enum. Console maps known hints; unknown hints show fallback message and link to docs.

Kevin Zhao: edge case: quota vs capacity vs rate-limit. Recommend separate codes: QUOTA_EXCEEDED, ROUTE_CAPACITY, RATE_LIMIT. Client SDKs should treat RATE_LIMIT as retry-after authoritative.

Sasha Ilyin: SDKs: surface humanBrief = response.brief OR mapHintToBrief(response.hint). Keep fallback to brief if hint unknown.

Lia Gomez: also add 'severity' in telemetry (info/warning/error) so dashboard alerting can be tuned without changing API surface.

Maya Patel: action items:
- @Henry Cole add enum defs + example responses to the API proto (due EOD)
- @Sasha Ilyin update SDK mapping rules and fallback behavior
- @Lia Gomez produce two banner length variants (short/long) for console
- @Kevin Zhao add telemetry tag spec and sampling plan

Henry Cole: I'll PR. small JSON schema in docs and a changelog entry.

Sasha Ilyin: SGTM

Lia Gomez: will draft copy and ping design

Maya Patel: thanks all — we'll review in standup tomorrow. :thumbsup:
